title: Higher-Order Quantum Objects are Strong Profunctors
summary: We explore the sense in which the existing constructions for higher-order maps on quantum theory based on causality constraints and compositionality constraints respectively, coincide. More precisely, we construct a functor F : Caus(C) -> StProf(C1) from higher-order causal categories to the category of strong profunctors over first-order causal processes that is lax-lax duoidal, full, faithful, and strongly closed whenever C is additive.
